summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (Bug Fixes & Test Infrastructure) of the cipher-box project, then review and clean up the resulting code, get a PR merged, and fix CI failures including a flaky web E2E recovery test.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 executed successfully with 3 plans (bin IPNS 404 fix, sdk-core load tests, recovery page cleanup), PR #361 merged after resolving CodeRabbit/Copilot review threads and CI failures. A separate PR #363 was created and merged to fix the recovery E2E test in CI (auth secret + Kubo CORS configuration).

repo: The `resolveIpnsRecord` function in sdk-core throws on transient HTTP errors (5xx, network) but returns `null` for explicit 404s — so `loadBin` auto-repair only triggers on genuine 'not found' responses, not transient failures.

IPNS records are published via a mock-ipns-routing service on port 3001 in CI, not Kubo's DHT. This means Kubo's gateway (port 8080) cannot resolve IPNS names in CI; the CipherBox API's DB cache (localhost:3000/ipns/resolve) is the only reliable resolver in that environment.

The web E2E workflow was missing `SDK_E2E_SECRET` env var that the recovery spec's `createTestAccount` helper reads from the SDK E2E harness. The API used `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` but the test process needed `SDK_E2E_SECRET`.

Kubo's CORS headers are not configured by default — browser-side code (recovery.html) cannot make cross-origin requests to localhost:8080 or localhost:5001 without explicit CORS config on the Kubo node.
The device registry underwent a v1→v2 schema migration: v2 requires SHA-256 `ipHash` instead of empty string; `validateRegistryShape()` was extracted to deduplicate v1/v2 validation logic.

TypeScript does not propagate narrowing from a called function back to the caller — after `validateRegistryShape(obj)` checks `Array.isArray(obj.devices)`, the caller still sees `obj.devices` as `unknown`; an explicit cast is required.
The `publishWithVerify` helper was initially re-publishing on every retry; it should publish once and only retry the verification step.
`computeIpHash()` already existed in `apps/web/src/lib/device/info.ts` — `useAuth.ts` was duplicating 7 lines of inline SHA-256 instead of using it.
Stale package builds (missing `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build`) caused 6 apparent type errors in the web app that disappeared after rebuilding `.d.ts` files.

code.finding: publishWithVerify should publish once then retry only verification, not re-publish on each retry attempt.
ipHash auto-healing should only accept empty string migration, not other malformed values. Cast needed after validateRegistryShape() due to TS cross-function narrowing limitation.
cid/pinSize must be declared above try block so the finally block can access them; TypeScript scopes let declarations to their block.

Recovery E2E test needs IPFS_GATEWAY_URL=localhost:8080 for content but IPNS resolution must go through CipherBox API (localhost:3000/ipns/resolve) in CI, not Kubo gateway, because IPNS is published via mock routing not DHT.
After auto-repair change, fresh bin sequenceNumber is 1 not 0 — loadBin now publishes immediately on 404.
Same sequenceNumber: 0 → 1 assertion fix required as in bin-operations E2E test.

workflow: The GSD execute-phase workflow runs 3 executor subagents in parallel for Wave 1, each with fresh 200k context; orchestrator stays at ~10-15% context.
Spot-checks after wave completion: verify SUMMARY.md exists, git log for commits matching plan prefix, check for Self-Check: FAILED marker.

When merging a PR branch while another branch has also completed, planning files (ROADMAP, STATE, REQUIREMENTS, PROJECT) all get conflicts that must be manually resolved by keeping both phases' changes.
CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot automated reviewers generate actionable comments; Copilot flagged ROADMAP.md table alignment issues in addition to code quality.
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug fires after tool calls complete and should be treated as success if spot-checks pass.

Recovery.html uses a multi-stage fallback for IPNS resolution: gateway /ipns/ path → delegated routing with retries → CipherBox API → Kubo API POST. Each stage has a timeout so total resolution time can exceed 37 seconds.

friction: GitHub API was intermittently unreachable, causing CI log fetches to timeout and requiring manual retries.
Recovery E2E test required multiple CI iterations to diagnose: first the missing SDK_E2E_SECRET, then the Kubo CORS issue, then the IPNS routing mismatch between mock-routing and Kubo DHT.
TypeScript doesn't propagate narrowing across function boundaries, requiring an explicit `as unknown[]` cast after validateRegistryShape() to fix a CI build failure that didn't reproduce locally.
Local Docker network reset (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) broke the API .env mid-session.
Playwright E2E test showed empty progress log with no error detail visible in screenshots — had to read error-context.md artifact for actual error messages.
Git push background tasks failed with exit 128 due to race conditions with foreground push, causing noisy false-alarm notifications.
The stash workflow was needed when the user tried to switch branches with uncommitted recovery.spec.ts changes.
open_items: Recovery E2E test still not confirmed passing in CI — final PR #363 fixes were pushed but CI run outcome was not confirmed before transcript ended.
Kubo CORS configuration in CI is done via `ipfs config` commands in a CI step — this is a workaround; ideally Kubo would start with CORS pre-configured in its Docker image or compose file.
Local recovery E2E test cannot run without either configuring Kubo CORS on the Docker host (192.168.133.12) or adding an IPFS content proxy endpoint to the CipherBox API.
The recovery.html IPNS resolution has a 30s timeout on the first gateway attempt before falling through to the API fallback — this makes tests slow and is inefficient.
Two SDK integration tests consistently fail with ECONNREFUSED when the API isn't running locally — these should either be tagged/skipped or the test environment should document the prerequisite.
Pre-existing type errors in byo-file-workload.ts were fixed as a side-effect of /simplify, but the load test suite has other pre-existing TS errors in different files.
